        it = 1e-09
    max_cap = float(np.max(b))
    score = (b - max_cap) ** 2 / it + b ** 2 / it ** 2
    score = score + b ** 2 / it ** 3
    gt = b > it
    score[gt] = -score[gt]
    prev = score[:-1].copy()
    score[1:] = score[1:] - prev
    exact = np.abs(b - it) < 1e-09
    if np.any(exact):
        score[exact] = np.max(np.abs(score)) + 1000000.0
    return score
